GLPenFind

Independent UK price index for private weight-care pens. Every pharmacy that publishes a price, per dose, with the date it was read.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://vedarjos.github.io/glpenfind-fdroid/repo
